name: @vortyx/deployment-root
description: Deployment glue for the single-project Vercel topology. The root api/[...route].ts catch-all re-uses the real platform API router (platform/api/src/vercel.ts). Phase 17: the Vercel buildCommand (scripts/build-api-bundle.mjs) bundles the catch-all WITH its whole runtime dependency chain (including @supabase/supabase-js, declared here) into one self-contained function file, so the lambda never resolves a cross-directory module at runtime. The scripts are never installed or used by the C++ build, the platform/api tests (which run inside platform/api with their own manifest), or the web console.
